notes: Low-poly stylized aesthetic with hand-painted look

blind.description: A low-poly stylized cartoon tree featuring a short, thick, flared brown trunk with exposed roots and a prominent stylized knot on one side. The canopy consists of several interconnected, bulbous clusters of hand-painted green foliage with layered shading. The structure is fully intact, standing directly on its rooted trunk base with no additional pedestal or terrain plate.
blind.from_above: An irregular, bumpy cluster of rounded dark-green lobes resembling a bunch of broccoli florets, casting a broad scalloped shadow onto the ground.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 1.8 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 9 to 10 feet tall), and about 2.5 to 3 times as wide (roughly 15 to 18 feet across the canopy).
